regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Kirkwood is forecast for about 39". Sugar Bowl about 32" and Palisades about 31". The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Kirkwood Wednesday and Wednesday night. The NWS is calling for more at Kirkwood: 35 to 60" Saturday night through Thursday night.

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth is forecast for about 31", 18" of it Thursday.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Whistler is forecast for about 15", 8" of it Saturday. Cypress Mountain about 5".

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Alta is forecast for about 8", 4" of it Tuesday. Brighton about 8" and Snowbird about 8". The NWS is calling for more at Alta: 24 to 46" Saturday through Thursday night.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Telluride is forecast for about 11", 6" of it Saturday. Crested Butte about 5" and Aspen Highlands about 4". The NWS is calling for more at Crested Butte: 3 to 8" Saturday through Thursday night.

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Wolf Creek is forecast for about 9", 6" of it Tuesday. Taos about 5". The NWS is calling for more at Wolf Creek: 17 to 33" Saturday through Thursday night. Winter Weather Advisory at Wolf Creek from Saturday to Saturday night.
